material.locator: HEC-HMS Application Guide, “How Should HEC-HMS be used?”, Step 2 — runoff hydrographs/flow-frequency information may feed hydraulic and consequence models; Step 9 — transfer of results to hydraulic/reservoir/consequence models.
material.description: The guide explicitly describes hydrologic outputs as inputs to hydraulic and consequence models. This does not establish the validity of any particular model transfer or site-specific result.
